plugins.name: wendy-iterating
plugins.description: General-purpose iterate-fix-and-ship loop: worktree per fix, PR workflow, loop pacing, and auto-terminate at 3 clean scans. Pair with a testing skill (e.g. wendy-cloud-testing) that supplies test commands and failure-mode knowledge.

plugins.name: wendy-cloud-testing
plugins.description: Wendy Cloud testing skill: prerequisites, stack setup, make test-swift/test-services, clean definition, failure-mode table, and device testing. Pair with wendy-iterating to drive a continuous fix loop.

plugins.name: wendy-gcp-deployment
plugins.description: Wendy's GCP deployment conventions: Pulumi (Go, GCS backend, KMS secrets), PoLP custom IAM roles, OIDC-only CI auth, wendy.sh/wendy.dev DNS rules, cost-efficiency, and dev/prod splits. Intermediate until the v1 consolidated deployment model.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: GitHub Actions hygiene for any workflow: prefer established actions over hand-rolled scripts, verify action versions at authoring time (never from memory), least-privilege permissions, OIDC-only cloud auth.

plugins.name: wendy-aaa-interop
plugins.description: The AAA contract between the wendy stack and the SaaS stack: responsibility split, two-key authority, credential shapes, signed artifacts, correlation_id, and the inter-service fabric. Foundation skill — pairs with wendy-certificates, wendy-device-enrollment, wendy-device-interop, wendy-security-baselines, wendy-self-hosted.

plugins.name: wendy-certificates
plugins.description: Requesting, renewing, and revoking certificates via pki-core: operator/service identity certs (token + proof-of-possession), entitlement-bearing certs via cloud grants, service accounts and CI without PATs, and key custody rules.

plugins.name: wendy-device-enrollment
plugins.description: WendyOS device enrollment and cert lifecycle: tiers A/B/C, ACME/EST flows, online and airgapped first-touch, post-expiry recovery, pinned platform root, and trusted time with anti-rollback.

plugins.name: wendy-device-interop
plugins.description: wendy-agent runtime interop: poll-only postbox, verifying operator-signed changes (hash chains, high-water marks, TSA timestamps), image pulls through wendy-proxy, and the device fail-safe catalogue.

plugins.name: wendy-security-baselines
plugins.description: Security invariants every Wendy interop change must respect: cloud-immune platform cap, fail-safe-only push signals, no bearer secrets, client-generated keys, PQ signing direction, tamper-evident audit, and a reject-on-sight anti-pattern list.

plugins.name: wendy-self-hosted
plugins.description: The Wendy dual-path rule: the wendy stack must always run without the SaaS stack. Deployment profiles, pluggable workload-identity backends, never-assume-GCP list, and the self-hosted review checklist for interop PRs.
